claim: CloudFormation dynamic references let a template specify external values stored and managed in other services, such as secure string parameters in Parameter Store or secrets in Secrets Manager, and so decouple sensitive information from the template; CloudFormation retrieves the value during stack and change set operations.

evidence.quote: Dynamic references provide a convenient way for you to specify external values stored and managed in other services and decouple sensitive information from your infrastructure-as-code templates. CloudFormation retrieves the value of the specified reference when necessary during stack and change set operations.
evidence.title: Get values stored in other services using dynamic references

evidence.quote: Use secure strings – For sensitive data, always use secure string parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store or secrets in AWS Secrets Manager to ensure your data is encrypted at rest.
